The P2 tier opener; the first governance/data-plane release (not a fourth initiator).

adrs.ADR-0064: Accepted 2026-07-12 (1f34d86) — Persistent Scoped Memory: Layer 2 of the three-layer context system alone (L1 Live Index deferred; L3 Reasoning Retrieval deferred + hard-gated — any embedding/AI dependency needs its own ADR against the offline+no-SaaS doctrine). A new sibling seam services/api/internal/memory (memories, migration 0012). Two content classes: the core is accrual by reference — a terminal Run writes a content-free evidence pointer in-tx on the shared once-only terminal flip (the EVD-1 promotion; zero secret-at-rest expansion); operator-authored free text is the secondary opt-in path (sealed at rest via the shared CommandSealer, operator-only read — the ADR-0059 posture). Governed forgetting = content-free tombstone events (memory.redacted/memory.expired, the ADR-0049 pattern; idempotent once-only flips); redact/expire govern the mutable projection ONLY — the chain, casts, and prior exports are out of reach by design. Operator-plane only: all verbs human-agent (/v1/memories*); the canonical agent-memory edge stays reserved-unenforced (no agent path, no gateway tool, no memory-fed execution — the cross-grant injection/exfiltration channel closed by construction; lighting it up shares a trigger with adaptive Workstreams). Expiry rides the existing api reaper (no 4th goroutine). Scopes {workstream, run, operator}; owner-scoped (GOV-7). confidence recorded-not-computed; DB-only storage with export rendering the filesystem-friendly manifest on demand. Extends ADR-0061 + ADR-0063; preserves ADR-0046/0049/0059/0060; edits no Accepted ADR (G2-clean).
